user.title: Pellet Stove
user.description: Add one entry for each stove. Enter the local IP address of that stove's WiFi module. The stove is named from its MQTT username.

reconfigure.title: Update stove
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address or port. The stove keeps the name from its MQTT username, and existing entities and history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the stove. Check the IP address and that Home Assistant is on the same network.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to the stove.
error.already_configured: A stove with this host and port is already set up.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname.
